input: Parallel AWS agent: aws-spend-guards + owner turnover runbook
errors: registry.opentofu.org is refused by the session proxy (403). Providers came from releases.hashicorp.com (reachable) with SHA256SUMS verified, into a filesystem mirror. The committed .terraform.lock.hcl files therefore carry only the linux_amd64 h1 hash; if the OpenTofu registry serves different zips, CI's first init fails loudly and `tofu providers lock -platform=linux_amd64 -platform=darwin_arm64` fixes it.
Installing Trivy (GitHub release tarball, checksum-verified) in the same command as Checkov was refused by the auto-mode classifier; Checkov alone installed and ran. Trivy config was not run.

doc_friction.issue: Says AWS has 'native limits, Paid-plan accounts only' as a hard cap. Searching found it is a per-project spend limit for accounts in the 'new AWS experience', limited rollout since September 2026, console-only with no API. It is not an account cap. Recorded in spend-guards/README.md, 'Native spend limits'; the report is left to its owner.

Shared AWS conventions name the state key and roles but not the organization stack's output for account ids; spend-guards assumes `account_ids` (map name->id) via optional org_state and falls back to explicit ids.

deviations.why: The draw picked quality/0; this run was assigned platform work by the AWS coordination brief, so it recorded under --track process.

The brief listed 'create the management account' and 'card' separately; AWS takes the card during sign-up, so they are one step. Billing access and the native spend limit got their own step (3) because both are root-only.

goal: Reach the AWS turnover point: spend guards apply-ready, the owner's steps written once.
notes:
Verification (all run here, 2026-11-24/25):
- python3 -m unittest discover -s platform/aws/spend-guards/lambda: Ran 36 tests, OK (no network, no boto3).
- OpenTofu v1.10.7 (release zip, SHA256SUMS verified) with hashicorp/aws 6.73.0 and archive 2.8.1: tofu fmt -check, init -backend=false, validate pass in modules/budget, spend-guards, spend-guards/member.
- tofu test: modules/budget 7 passed; spend-guards 11 passed; spend-guards/member 2 passed.
- checkov (latest from PyPI) -d spend-guards -d modules/budget --framework terraform: 51 passed, 0 failed, 2 skipped (CKV_AWS_117 Lambda VPC: NAT/endpoints cost more than the guard; CKV_AWS_272 code signing: needs the org's Signer profile).
- decision_queue.py --check: 9 decisions, schema OK; test_decision_queue.py 83 passed. workctl.py validate ok.
Nothing applied; no AWS account exists. Hand-off for siblings: the organization stack should output `account_ids` (map account name -> id) and adopt the console-created Organization with an import block (OWNER_RUNBOOK step 4).
